title: The Living Stone Archive

features.name: seam-that-conducts-memory
features.desc-on-touch: The stone opens along a line where trace metals formed geometries. You read data written in mineral layers, each stratum a year the earth was listening.

features.name: stratified-response
features.desc-on-touch: The layers shift when you approach. Fossils within reorder themselves, each one a quartz node remembering where it fell.

features.name: circuit-in-the-red-earth
features.desc-on-touch: Iron oxide conducts what the archive sent down. The path glows: a message that learned to live as rust.

features.name: fossil-that-reads
features.desc-on-touch: An impression of a spiral shell, but the spirals move. The fossil learned to interpret itself by being touched by stones older than it.

features.name: the-voltage-vein
features.desc-on-touch: A mineral vein that grew in sympathy with the archive's transmission. It hums at the frequency of old stone remembering wetness.

inscription: the bedrock learned to archive by letting minerals conduct what water had forgotten

file.name: StoneMemory_Conductivity_Cross-Section_2.3mDepth.spec
file.note: Mineral lattices that formed in response to decades of transmitted data; the archive's fingerprints in the earth itself.

exits.label: the route back up through the stone
deeper still to where crystals learn to grow alone
along the vein to where the earth's oldest broadcast still echoes
downward to the layer where all debts become one debt
